Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

The Mechanical Commissioning Engineer (m/f/d) is responsible for planning, executing, and validating the commissioning of mechanical systems in data centre construction projects. This role ensures that all systems are installed, tested, and operating according to design specifications, safety standards, and client requirements.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and manage multi-disciplinary project teams in alignment with commissioning plans, ensuring compliance with design standards, local codes, and industry best practices.

- Oversee all commissioning arrangements, testing sequences, documentation, and progress tracking.
- Coordinate closely with project partners, client commissioning teams, and subcontractors to ensure seamless handover of systems and services.
- Oversee the closure of all observations, non-conformities, and commissioning-related issues to the full satisfaction of the client and the organization.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's Degree or Postgraduate Diploma in Engineering (Chemical/Mechanical), Science & Technology, or related disciplines.
- Many years of experience in commissioning, including proven success in a senior commissioning or leadership role.
- Strong expertise in commissioning procedures, legal standards, and certification requirements.
- Demonstrated experience with commissioning of Data Centers or similarly complex technical environments.
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and internal teams.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for interacting with the project team and client representatives

What we offer

- Do you appreciate working in a multidisciplinary environment? We are the right place for you

jobs.occupation: Subsystems Engineer (m/f/d) - Data Handling Systems (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Your tasks are mission-dependent and evolve throughout the life cycle of our spacecraft design and implementation process, from initial conception to the support of the launch campaign. Depending on your experience and preferences the tasks may include - Design and specification of the data handling subsystem
- Evaluation of technical proposals from suppliers
- Technical officer guiding the unit procurements throughout the lifecycle (from conception, through design and implementation phases, until unit-level verification)
- Data handling subsystem integration into the spacecraft
- Unit- and subsystem verification
Your Qualifications

- A degree in engineering with a major in electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, systems engineering, or compatible qualification
- Self-managed, proactive and solution-oriented working style
- Ability to work in a multi-cultural team
- Fluency in spoken and written English
- Fluency in German is desired (language skills can be improved through company-facilitated trainings)

Your Tasks

- Technical coordination of cybersecurity-related tasks with customer, subcontractors and internal technical disciplines
- Flow down of the security requirements to subsystem and equipment level specifications
- Ensure compliance to the security technical requirements
- Support the generation the AIT plans and operation plans
- Support preparation of satellite tests and review of test results with focus on security functions
- Define Test Specifications for Security tests and verification
- Support preparation for launch and flight phases, preparation of launcher interfaces and for operations data
- Contribute to the project risk management for risks of security nature
Your Qualifications

- Degree in engineering, physics or equivalent
- Professional experience in satellite projects, preferably in phases B/C/D
- Good conceptual and problem-solving skills
- Well-developed communication and negotiation skills
- High motivation, pro-active working approach and strong sense of responsibility
- Team-minded and ideally accustomed to work in internationally composed team
- Fluency in both spoken and written English, German language skills are highly desirable

You are interested in this position but don’t meet all the requirements or lack experience? No problem! We support you with a personalized development plan to grow into this role. Your motivation to bring things forward is of more value than your specific experience in these domains.
